propositions: Three near-identical walkers (find_replacement, _has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target) discover a ticket's replacement link by iterating deps and inbound relationships; they differ only in liveness check and return type, creating maintenance hazard and bug vector.

The replacement-link walk (find_inbound_relationships combined with supersedes) must have exactly one body under src/rebar/; the walk consolidation lacks a construct-uniqueness guard test to prevent re-introduction of duplicates.
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES and DISPOSITION_CLASSES must be the same object to prevent drift; they must be structurally linked, not restated separately.

The three walkers differ in class filtering (find_replacement guards on DISPOSITION_CLASSES only; _has_live_replacement_link additionally narrows non-bugs to ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES; _recorded_replacement_target has no class guard) and reduce-failure handling (find_replacement returns early; _recorded_replacement_target continues to inbound scan); these differences must be preserved in the shared core.
A consolidated replacement_of() function must support both require_live and on_subject_unreadable modes to handle divergent caller expectations without weakening fail-closed verification paths.

Monkeypatch seams _has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, and find_replacement must keep exact names and signatures to preserve test compatibility and detect silent breakage of patched behavior.
